# V2 artifact sidecar UX runtime-evidence addendum

Verdict: **PASS for the scoped producer/model-transport UX evidence**, zero actionable findings. This is a read-only assessment of captured execution; this reviewer ran no Cargo, Gradle, app, SDK probe or Rust executable. It does not grant native UI, integrated project-tree, full IDE, full workspace CI, reference-flow completion, lead merge, or push gates.

Source commit: `830ff53de76dbecd5fc3761f1c5f5bae164763c2`, worktree `/workspace/android-studio-source-providers`. The frozen production module is `5264e4c00d8958a4aaee250c7d924ae89e4665f778b893156442f6af3ed52be0`; bridge is `508ecc9987932f8d184983f551eca0cb1bc9efa6ed12806dcaff8a0a2f6880b7`;28-test source is `9900069b1a993875795c4be1feadf5f4a8da2a5750f486beb4596ae6b45efbf1`. These match the final reviewed source and current files. Current environment observations are connected/running. Only this external report was written; no source/cache/branch change or agent was created.

## Actual captured execution reviewed

The raw log for normal `cargo test --locked -p android_tools --all-features --message-format=json` has six unfiltered successful summaries:85 library,28 generated-artifact,20 import,21 tree-component,29 tree-facts,19 preference tests, totaling202 passed,0 failed,0 ignored,0 filtered. Both original ordering adaptations and the reported null/empty and positional-array regressions appear as passing cases. Compiler JSON names this exact worktree's manifests/source paths and marks the android_tools library, library tests and generated_artifacts test executable fresh:false. The crate-root freshness touch preserved root bytes. Thus the results are bound to the actual current task source, rather than a reused artifact from a different worktree.

Strict `./script/clippy --locked -p android_tools` completed exit0, with the raw command showing release/all-targets/all-features and deny warnings. `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and normal locked all-features library build also exited0. The subsequent library build correctly reused the same library freshly compiled during the202-test run; it is not presented as a second new compilation.

The standalone Rust observation driver links that normal Cargo library; its compiler receipt names the matching dependency fingerprint and same artifact. Current library hash matches recorded `bf2d8ee866f659ee864387a311a0749c168b3c2e6fb06c06226ca8f0713e00ff`; dedicated driver source matches `5551985487b7e87f31963365ccf203f138de5f7bb4ebb2d5f4ca9d9b9a971dca`; executable matches `531cc5f5ee7ca35a304513a9f8ab0b8f7246232e8674a10fa5239f4dfd19702f`. All were checked by reading/hashing only, without running them.

## Prior boundary findings now covered by execution

The boundary probe executes byte-exact copied production bridge helper ranges under cached Groovy4.0.32, using controlled getter objects. It serializes11 cases and a current Rust driver asserts their observed outcomes. Both processes exited0. This is a bridge-helper negative regression with controlled objects, not an assertion that the official SDK returns malformed null getters.

Actual null/wrong-type collections and maps serialize as Unavailable with the exact getter capability and explanatory detail; legitimate empty collections/maps remain Available([]). Ordered duplicate paths remain z/a/z. A null source getter in a present Android artifact stays unavailable without erasing the artifact; a legitimate empty Android getter remains available-empty; nullable Android task-name values remain null; Java Android resource/assets/task getters remain NotApplicable; a null artifact remains explicitly Absent. These outputs resolve the original UX null-to-empty finding at the actual serialization boundary. The normal28-test run separately verifies the typed receiving parser and rejects array envelopes, nested DTO arrays and tagged-slot arrays, including absent/null positional payloads.

The boundary source identity record's executed:false is its retained preparation-time state; the later run/assertion receipts and raw output establish actual execution. Historical preparation metadata was not rewritten to conceal chronology.

## Five official supplementary SDK captures

All five source/bytecode/custom/disabled/disabled-artifact Gradle invocations completed exit0 with raw BUILD SUCCESSFUL lines; each corresponding current Rust-driver observation/variant assertion completed exit0. The frozen full production bridge is byte-identical to current508ecc. Per-mode app-configuration snapshot hashes match their invocation receipts. The inspection script invokes actual official BuildConfig tasks and reads task output properties; it does not classify folder names to invent source/JAR identity.

All actual Versions records retain AGP9.4.0, producer23.0 with its SDK-provided description, minimum consumer66.1 with its SDK-provided description, and individual model schema identities. Gradle receipts/daemon logs identify9.6.1 and JDK21 at the recorded JDK21.0.12.1+1 home. These are supplementary observations, not equivalence to the pinned Studio9.5-dev helper or the five original SIMPLE_APPLICATION project-view flows.

| Captured mode | Observable producer/transport result |
| --- | --- |
| Source | Official type JAVA_SOURCE; source folders contain the exact official main BuildConfig task output; generated classpaths are available-empty. |
| Bytecode | Official type JAR; BuildConfig is retained under exact SDK generated-classpath key buildConfigGeneratedClasses, matching official task bytecode output; the JAR is not in source folders. The captured Rust assertion checked file existence and ZIP signature. |
| Custom field with bytecode requested | Official type JAVA_SOURCE, with actual FACT_STRING fields on the main tasks; task source outputs are modeled and BuildConfig JAR key is absent. |
| Disabled BuildConfig | Official creation type is available-null, official BuildConfig task list is empty, and raw modeled folders/classpaths omit the prior official source output/JAR while retaining AP roots. This is distinct from getter unavailable or an absent main artifact. |
| Explicitly disabled release test artifacts | Debug host/device SDK keys remain modeled, release host/device maps are available-empty, and test fixtures remain explicitly absent. The baseline already had release maps empty; this run confirms the explicit-disable state, not a newly observed before/after removal or a new original test port. |

The driver uses the public Basic parser and sidecar parser, checks current revision binding, exact modeled variant identities, pinned feature accessors, outside-build generated res/assets roots, absent fixture slot, and MissingVariant for inactiveDebug. Raw V2 folders do not imply visible Studio filtering/grouping; this report gives no AAPT/data-binding/SafeArgs/external-KAPT or Kotlin-facet equivalence credit. Current passing Rust tests preserve legacy Basic import independently and distinguish unsupported/unavailable/minimum-consumer/schema/stale states without empty fallbacks.

## Preservation, cleanup and limits

The entire fixed-exclusion execution guard4612 files still matches current source bytes; all8 final frozen files and184 protected originals match. The old fixture and restored private copy each match all13 input hashes. Every frozen round1/2/3 source and snapshot matches its historical hashes; both earlier FAIL reports, round3 PASS and final test addendum retain their recorded hashes. Failed fix preparations and the pre-Cargo missing-/usr/bin/time launch attempt remain retained; that failed launch explicitly started no Cargo/compiler/SDK operation.

Cleanup receipts and raw owned-daemon logs are consistent: all five daemon log hashes match, logs record shutdown, and each owned PID is absent under /proc when inspected. The former255023 process is reported absent in the final cleanup record; the previously unowned167092 daemon was left untouched. No process was stopped by this reviewer. Final cleanup explains Git index-byte changes from stat/cache refresh while clean blob-tree/content guards preserve source; this is not concealed as unchanged raw index bytes.

The five original generated-tree model/file/refresh/UI flows and ModelVersionsTest.checkSupportsParallelSync remain unported. The two ordering tests pass in the scoped28-test suite, but canonical ledger promotion remains Root-owned and pending source-bound capture gates. No matrix row or test was changed by this reviewer. The existing Gradle/SDK JVM getter bridge remains the documented unavoidable interop exception; version policy, validation and assertions stay in Rust.

Root's combined full-app/native workflow, full workspace checks/CI, updated source-bound parity captures, lead review and protected integration merge/push remain separate required gates. This PASS approves the reviewed supplemental producer and transport outcomes only.
